Present Simple yzygiderli, adaty hereketler üçin ulanylýar.

I / you / we / they + işlik: I play.
he / she / it + işlik + s: She plays.

Inkär: don't / doesn't + işlik: He doesn't play.
Sorag: Do / Does …? Does she play?
text.ru:
Present Simple используется для регулярных, привычных действий.

I / you / we / they + глагол: I play.
he / she / it + глагол + s: She plays.

Отрицание: don't / doesn't + глагол: He doesn't play.
Вопрос: Do / Does …? Does she play?
